args.title: Triage issue #4409: update README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: Running locally instructions in README.md mention MinIO as a container option but do not specify S3_ENDPOINT or bucket creation, causing uploads to fail against AWS S3 defaults.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Running locally instructions in README.md mention MinIO as a container option but do not specify S3_ENDPOINT or bucket creation, causing uploads to fail against AWS S3 defaults.
